name: qa-compliance
description: Compliance testing for GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, HIPAA, PCI DSS v4.0, SOC 2 and ISO/IEC 27001: control tests, audit-trail tests, and evidence collection. Scores existing tests and evidence against a framework's criteria, packages SOC 2 Type II evidence for auditors, and runs an adversarial readiness review.
